purpose: Local gameplay prototype: witness a watchman transform, attack a villager, feed, then repel or evade him.
runtimeSurface: Existing Three.js /explore scene; no room rebuild or GLB export.

exceptions: Existing village architecture retained. Two deliberately staggered actors preserve the north route.

circulation.description: Existing lane x=-4..4. Watchman (-0.9,-7.5), victim (1.2,-9.5). West bypass x=-2.5 stays open. Escape north past z=-19 or >19m from creature.

performanceBudget.note: Prototype increment target: <50000 triangles; shared geometries/materials, no new texture downloads. Full-device performance unbenchmarked.
